entities.summary: Mirza Abdollah, also known as Agha Mirza Abdollah Farahani, was a tar and setar player. He is among the most significant musicians in Iran's history. Born in Farahan, he and his younger brother Mirza Hossein-Qoli started learning music from their father Ali-Akbar Farahani who was a well-known musician.
